prompts.Fox: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single FULL BODY red fox character illustration on a truly transparent background, for a layered animated storybook. Image 1 is the definitive existing storybook STYLE AND IDENTITY reference (top left and top right panels). Image 2 is supporting facial design reference. The fox is graceful, slender, believable red-fox anatomy, small alert almond amber eyes, a long tapered narrow muzzle, deep brown tiny nose, pointed ears with dark edges and cream inner fur, vivid russet orange fur and cream ivory throat, slim dark brown lower legs, an exceptionally beautiful long bushy tail with an ivory tip. Standing in a calm natural pose, body in three-quarter side view facing LEFT, head raised slightly looking left toward a child. All four paws visible and grounded at the same level, tail sweeping behind toward the RIGHT without overlapping the legs. Capture the original illustration's exquisite individual directional brush strokes, softly broken fur edges, luminous warm golden light from upper left, blue violet touches in shaded cream fur, rich gouache over transparent watercolor. Precise elegant silhouette; do NOT make a baby fox, plush toy, rounded dog face or plastic 3D character. Full character including all ears, paws and tail contained with 7% clear transparent padding, landscape 3:2 composition. Exactly one fox, no scenery, no grass, no shadow floor, no paper rectangle, no text. This is a 2D painted character texture, not a claim of a rendered 3D model.
prompts.FoxClean: Edit the provided fox illustration. Preserve exactly the fox anatomy, pose, face, all fur brushwork, colors, every paw, tail and ear. Remove ONLY the large diffuse yellow/orange glow around the silhouette. Produce a clean truly transparent background: every pixel outside the fine actual fur silhouette should be fully transparent. No black background, no halo, no fog, no shadows or ground. Keep the illuminated fine fur edge itself, but remove the surrounding cloud of yellow-orange light. Preserve the whole fox uncropped. Keep original size and composition. It is a clean character cutout for compositing.
prompts.Prince: Use case: illustration-story. Make a single FULL BODY Little Prince character, matching the exact child identity and rich hand-painted storybook style in image 1 (the project illustration, top left panel) and image 2 (supporting face reference). Truly transparent background. A slim young boy age about 7-8, natural child proportions, a delicate rounded jaw, small softly modeled nose, warm brown curious eyes, subtly rosy cheeks, abundant golden windswept CURLS made of tapering painterly locks. His expression is tender, thoughtful and alive. He stands in a relaxed THREE-QUARTER view facing RIGHT and looks slightly down to the right at a fox. One arm hangs naturally with fingers visible; the other rests softly at his side. Forest/moss green knee-length coat with irregular watercolor shadows and golden reflected light, folded tailored lapels, rolled cuffs, muted brass buttons, slender brown belt, warm gray-beige trousers, beautifully painted brown leather ankle boots. A mustard gold scarf is wrapped loosely around his neck and its long two tails blow to the LEFT, graceful fabric folds, fringed ends, fully in frame. Subtle asymmetry in hair and posture, NOT a toy, not plastic, not a bobblehead, not generic Pixar. Exquisite traditional gouache and watercolor painting, directional expressive strokes with dry-brush broken edges, warm golden light upper left with restrained rimlight and transparent edges, subtle violet in shadows, consistent with the existing book. Single boy full figure, portrait 3:4, all curls, scarf tips and both boots visible with 7% padding. No scenery, no floor, no backdrop glow, no rectangle, no shadow plane, no other character, no text. This is an illustrated texture for an animated storybook, not a real 3D render.
prompts.Background: Use case: illustration-story. Image 1 is the style, palette and location reference for an existing Little Prince storybook. Create ONE cohesive LANDSCAPE 3:2 background painting of the same golden wheat field, designed as a background plate behind separately animated characters. Beautiful gnarled apple-tree trunk framing the far LEFT edge, branches and olive green leaves arching across top left, a few red apples. Rich golden sunlit wheat field in the middle distance, lavender blue distant hills and a tiny hilltop village on the far horizon. Warm cream sky, soft golden clouds. In the foreground create a quiet grassy clearing with a subtle path across lower third: the central foreground area MUST be open and low-detail so a child on the left and a fox on the right can stand here. Small daisies, clover, grass tufts and fallen red apples clustered only near outer bottom corners. Landscape fills frame edge-to-edge. Luminous watercolor and gouache, intricate hand-painted brushwork, atmospheric perspective, warm honey-gold and olive green, bright but restrained. Absolutely NO people, NO fox, NO animals, no text, no panels or borders. This must look painted by the same illustrator as the reference. Keep the horizon around 48% from the top, clearing at 75-90% down. No wide camera distortion.
